title: fix: sandbox quick fixes from user feedback
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Sandbox creation now defaults to `autoPause: true`: when a lease expires, an E2B SDK or CLI sandbox created without an explicit lifecycle setting pauses and keeps its files instead of being deleted. An explicit `autoPause: false` still requests deletion. `GET /alpha/e2b/pricing` now returns fixed rates and template sizes without authentication. The dashboard explains what a sandbox is, labels GB as memory, shows each template’s calculated hourly cost and an always-on monthly estimate based on 720 hours, and clarifies that paused sandboxes cost nothing. Sandbox docs explain the pause default, SSH and VS Code access, and the public pricing endpoint. Polli’s reference directs sandbox questions to the current docs. The sandbox template adds an SSH login message with commands to try and instructions for keeping a sandbox running.
